newsitem.title: USA: Incentive AB clears waiting period.
newsitem.headline: Incentive AB clears waiting period.

text.p: Incentive AB said on Monday that it had cleared the Hart-Scott Rodino Antitrust waiting period in its tender offer for Vivra Inc.
Incentive also said that with the early termination of the waiting period it had been cleared by authorities concerning antitrust concerns.
The waiting period related to the company's $35.62 per share cash tender offer for Vivra, Incentive said in a statement. The early termination became effective on May 16, it added.

"As previously announced, Incentive intends to merge Vivra's renal care business with the Gambro Group," Incentive said. The Gambro Group is Incentive's wholly owned dialysis and medical technology business.
Incentive's tender offer for Vivra is scheduled to expire at midnight EST on June 6, the company said.
Incentive is an industrial group with core operations in medical technology, materials handling and the environment.
